source.name: Attack

These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased. Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, basic attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.

source.name: Nock Nock
source.originalDescription: Fires quills in the designated direction for 5s, dealing damage to enemies but does not pierce through them. The move ends by unleashing a large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits (30% more damage if the target is below 50% HP) but Nock Nock can be cancelled early. While using this move, Decidueye becomes unstoppable but is unable to move. Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The move ends by unleashing a particularly large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits. This move deals increased damage if the enemies remaining HP is low. While using this move, Decidueye becomes immune to hindrances but is unable to move. Buffs: 30% Max HP Shield granted at the start of the Move, 30% Movement Speed granted at the end of the turret
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Nock Nock は 移動不能を付与する、妨害無効になる、シールドを付与する、HP割合条件で発動する、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する。
